scope: XIRI_IP30_M3B2 validates the PROM-assigned IOC3 BAR0/Bridge window 2 pairing, installs polled IOC3 UART A as the kernel console, and prints direct and console-path markers. BAR/window programming, IOC3 interrupts, RTC/Ethernet/keyboard/mouse, and full IOC3 attachment are not implemented.

implementation.attachment: ioc3early0 at mainbus0 addr 0x1f600000 (Bridge short window, PCI slot 2)
implementation.validation: maps type-0 configuration at 0x1f022000 and reads IOC3 BAR0 at 0x10; reads Bridge device register 2 at 0x1f000214; requires non-zero, non-all-ones, aligned BAR0 whose PCI base bits match the window base and whose window has the memory bit set
implementation.uart: polled 16550 UART A at slot-2 window offset 0x20178 (physical 0x1f620178); LSR bit 5 THRE and LSR bit 0 DR; 32-bit Bridge/PCI config and device-window reads
implementation.console: direct UART marker before cn_tab, then installs ioc3early_cn and prints the console marker through kernel printf
implementation.success_checks: BAR0/window2 base and memory-space agreement, direct UART marker, then kernel printf after cn_tab installation
implementation.not_programmed: BAR0 and Bridge window 2 remain at the PROM assignment; no PCI interrupt mapping or IOC3 device driver

observations: M2B HEART and M3 Bridge/PCI markers passed; this retained run stops before the clock and interrupt-delivery markers (see review_validation for the longer boot)
ioc3early0 at mainbus0 addr 0x1f600000: IOC3 BAR0 0x500000 window2 0x10011005 (window base 5, memory space)
kernel console marker XIRI_IP30_M3B2_IOC3_CONSOLE after cn_tab installation
the subsequent entropy warning is carried by IOC3, proving kernel printf uses the new console
run.emulator: retained native-20261115 release, default tlbvmap features, interpreter, LTO=false, codegen-units=16, debug=0

XIRI_O2.note: config does not include ioc3early; no guest boot was rerun

XIRI_INDY64.note: config does not include ioc3early; no guest boot was rerun

regressions.latest_guest_runs: M1/O2/Indy64 latest native guest runs remain the M2b-fix baselines; M3a, M3b1 and M3b2 guest runs are recorded in their respective manifests.

not_proven: IOC3 interrupt delivery and interrupt-driven serial
Full root boot and multi-user login
next_milestone: Attach an interrupt-capable IOC3 driver while retaining the polled console; then add Bridge/HEART interrupt mapping and the QLogic storage path.

review_validation.artifact_retention: Temporary /tmp review artifacts; original retained milestone run remains unchanged. Use a fresh output directory to repeat the command.
